Test Case Title: Register with a valid unique email and a policy-compliant password
Precondition: User is on the Sign Up page; email has not been used before
Steps: 1. Navigate to /ai_dashboard/agnos/sign_up 2. Enter a unique valid email 3. Enter a password meeting the policy 4. Enter the same value in Confirm Password 5. Click Confirm
Expected Result: Account is created and the user is taken off the sign-up page (e.g. to login or dashboard)
Actual Result: POST /api/ai_dashboard/create_user returns HTTP 500 {"error_message":"internal_server_error"}; user remains on the sign-up page with no error message shown
Comments: See BUG-002. Reproduced with 3 different unique emails.
